headline: Why Tyson Foods (TSN) Stock Is Trading Up Today
summary: Shares of meat company Tyson Foods (NYSE:TSN) jumped 6.4% in the morning session after the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) announced it would resume importing cattle from Mexico and on news of new tariffs on Canadian goods. The USDA confirmed a phased reopening of southern cattle ports, starting August 24, 2026, which will allow for a limited amount of cattle imports from Mexico following a parasite outbreak.
